title: tests/integration/oidc09_jit_provisioning_test.zig, oidc10_attribute_sync_test.zig, oidc11_identity_stability_test.zig (and oidc12/15/35) are not wired into any zig build target -- their test blocks never run
notes: Discovered while implementing ISS-0100 (GitHub #357) Iteration 3 (oidc09/10/11 tenant fixture hygiene fix). While applying the fix, confirmed via grep that none of oidc09_jit_provisioning_test.zig, oidc10_attribute_sync_test.zig, oidc11_identity_stability_test.zig, oidc12_realm_tenant_binding_test.zig, oidc15_realm_deletion_test.zig, or oidc35_onboarding_test.zig are imported by tests/integration/main_test.zig or referenced by any build.zig addTest/step block (`grep -n "oidc09\|oidc10_attribute\|oidc11_identity\|oidc12_realm\|oidc15_realm\|oidc35_onboarding" tests/integration/main_test.zig build.zig` returns zero matches). These 6 files collectively contain dozens of test blocks (oidc09 alone has 10) that cannot currently execute via `zig build test-integration` or any per-suite target -- they are dead code from a CI/build perspective, regardless of their own correctness. This means whatever OIDC JIT-provisioning, attribute-sync, identity-stability, realm-tenant-binding, realm-deletion, and onboarding behavior these tests were meant to verify has had zero automated coverage for an unknown period, and the ISS-0100 fixture-hygiene fix applied to oidc09/10/11 in this same run is itself currently unverified by CI (it was hand-verified via direct `zig test` invocation outside the normal build graph during ISS-0100 Iteration 3, not via a wired build step).
candidate_resolution: Add the missing files to tests/integration/main_test.zig's import list (matching the pattern used for already-wired sibling files like adp07_agent_role_reserved_usernames_test.zig) and confirm they run as part of the test-integration / test-integration-svc aggregate step, or -- if there is a reason they were deliberately excluded (e.g. known-broken, superseded by a later test, or intentionally quarantined) -- document that reason inline and either delete the dead files or add an explicit skip marker with a linked issue, rather than leaving them silently unreachable. Needs its own WF-03 scoping decision; not part of ISS-0100's fix.
